newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Steel says to cancel new plant project.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Steel says to cancel new plant project.

text.p: Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would cancel a project for a new plant in central Japan.
Tokyo Steel was unable to reach agreement with local officials due to various reasons, the Japanese steel maker said in a statement.
Tokyo Steel said it had acquired 165,000 sq metres of land in Mie prefecture in late 1992 to build a steel and rolling mill.
A spokesman for Tokyo Steel was not immediately available for comment.
